the design and realization of a multisensorial system that can be used to detect the presence of different chemical substances in a sample, both in the gaseous and liquid phases.

we have designed, fabricated, tested and characterized a novel biosensors-based multisensorial device for mimicking the nose, tongue, and eyes.
the BIONOTE platform can be considered as a proof of concept of the possibility to use the same sensing materials for both liquid and gaseous sensors.
a new biosensor-based multisensorial device has been designed, fabricated and calibrated, which is intended to mimic human senses.

a single sensing material can be used to realize a multisensorial system that is able to detect both gas and liquid analytes.
